title: Formal-neighbourhood flatness at a depth-two section
statement: Let S be a Noetherian integral quasi-separated scheme, c:C→S a quasi-compact quasi-separated smooth morphism, σ:S→C a section, U an open containing the generic point, and PA a finite etale cover of C_U. If s∉U is minimal among points outside U under specialization and the stalk depth at s is at least two, then the relative normalization pulled back to Spec O_{S,s} is flat on a neighbourhood of the section closed point, whenever that pullback morphism is finite.

source.place: Tag 0EYJ, formal-neighbourhood calculation in the proof of Tag 0EYJ

proof.text: Complete a smooth affine chart at the section. The punctured finite etale algebra is split by the rational section and its translates; the depth-two extension and normality identify it with the completed normalization. Faithfully flat descent gives flatness at every point over the section closed point. The finite flat locus is open and the image of its closed complement is closed, so deleting that image gives the required neighbourhood.

lean.statement: theorem stalk_normalization_depth_two_section_flat_core {S C : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian S] [QuasiSeparatedSpace S] [IsIntegral S] (c : C ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact c] [QuasiSeparated c] [Smooth c] (σ : S ⟶ C) (hσ : σ ≫ c = 𝟙 S) (U : S.Opens) (hηU : genericPoint S ∈ U) (PA : (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme.FiniteEtale) (s : S) (hs : s ∉ U) (hmin : ∀ t : S, t ⤳ s → t ∉ U → t = s) (hdepth : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := S.presheaf.stalk s) (S.presheaf.stalk s)) : letI : IsFinite PA.obj.hom := PA.property letI : QuasiCompact (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι := MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (isPullback_morphismRestrict c U) (inferInstance : QuasiCompact U.ι) let a := S.fromSpecStalk s let n := pullback.snd (PA.obj.hom ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).fromNormalization (pullback.fst c a) let τ : Spec (S.presheaf.stalk s) ⟶ pullback c a := pullback.lift (a ≫ σ) (𝟙 _) (by simp [Category.assoc, hσ]) IsFinite n → ∃ W : (pullback c a).Opens, τ (IsLocalRing.closedPoint (S.presheaf.stalk s)) ∈ W ∧ Flat (n ∣_ W)
